title: Phone Number Prefix
description: You are given a string array `numbers` that represents phone numbers. Return `true` if no phone number is a prefix of any other phone number; otherwise, return `false`.
constraints: All numbers contain only digits '0' to '9'.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Phone Number Prefix.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
